haiku.problem: This asks about a minor image (the heavy stone). The spirit of grace and prayer poured out on the house of David and Jerusalem (Prep card 2-2) is clearly more central to the passage and was left out.

The question repeats the verse up to the answer, 'look on the One they had pierced,' then asks what they will do 'for Him.' The answer 'Mourn for Him' is the next words of that line, which breaks the rule against asking the baker to guess the next words. The answer also repeats 'for Him' from the question.
